description: Java class implementing a WearableListenerService for handling configuration messages for a digital watch face on Android Wear OS, including managing GoogleApiClient connections and processing incoming messages.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceConfigListenerService
classes.description: A service listening for configuration messages for a digital watch face and updating settings accordingly.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, checks message path, initializes GoogleApiClient if needed, connects if not connected, and updates configuration data.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is suspended.
